# Rajasthan Tourism

> > Official tourism portal of the Government of Rajasthan showcasing heritage forts, palaces, temples, and destinations across India's royal desert state.

This is the Department of Tourism, Government of Rajasthan's official website, providing comprehensive information about tourist destinations, historical monuments, forts, and travel experiences across Rajasthan's major cities including Jaipur, Udaipur, Jodhpur, Jaisalmer, and Ajmer. The site features detailed guides to UNESCO World Heritage Sites, temple complexes, and cultural attractions throughout the state.

## Key Topics

- Rajasthan Tourism
- Jaipur - Pink City
- Heritage Forts and Palaces
- Amber Fort/Palace
- Ajmer Sharif Dargah
- Kumbhalgarh Fort
- Jaisalmer Fort
- Mehrangarh Fort
- Chittorgarh Fort
- Historical Monuments
- Aravalli Hills
- Jain Temples
- Desert Tourism
- Royal Heritage Sites
- Cultural Destinations

## Essential Tourist Information

- [Rajasthan at a Glance](http://www.tourism.rajasthan.gov.in/about-rajasthan.html): Overview of Rajasthan state with key destinations and travel information
- [Top Tourist Places to Visit in Rajasthan](http://www.tourism.rajasthan.gov.in/tourist-destinations.html): Complete list of Rajasthan tourist places, monuments, and destinations
- [Forts in Rajasthan](http://www.tourism.rajasthan.gov.in/forts.html): Rajasthan forts: Chittorgarh, Amber, Mehrangarh, Jaisalmer heritage sites

## Major Forts and Palaces

- [Amber Palace in Jaipur](http://www.tourism.rajasthan.gov.in/amber-palace.html): Amber Palace/Fort in Jaipur with underground tunnels to Jaigarh Fort
- [Kumbhalgarh Fort: The Mewar Fortress](http://www.tourism.rajasthan.gov.in/kumbhalgarh-fort.html): Kumbhalgarh Fort in Aravalli ranges with 38 km walls, second-longest

## City Destinations

- [Ajmer Tourism](http://www.tourism.rajasthan.gov.in/ajmer.html): Ajmer tourism: Ajmer Sharif Dargah, Taragarh Fort, Aravalli Hills
- [Banswara Tourism](http://www.tourism.rajasthan.gov.in/banswara.html): Banswara 'City of hundred islands' with Dialab Lake, Anand Sagar Lake
- [Hanumangarh Tourism](http://www.tourism.rajasthan.gov.in/hanumangarh.html): Hanumangarh city: Bhatner Fort, Kalibangan, Mata Bhadrakali Temple

## Temples and Religious Sites

- [Jain Temples in Jaisalmer](http://www.tourism.rajasthan.gov.in/jain-temples-of-jaisalmer.html): 12th-15th century Jain Temples in Jaisalmer Fort, Dilwara architecture

## Travel Diaries and Experiences

- [Umang's Rajasthan Journey](http://www.tourism.rajasthan.gov.in/travel-diaries/umangsthan.html): Travel diary entry featuring Rajasthan destinations including Ajmer, Alwar
- [Sudipto's Rajasthan Journey](http://www.tourism.rajasthan.gov.in/travel-diaries/sudiptosthan.html): Travel diary entry covering Rajasthan tourist destinations and experiences
- [Sharad's Rajasthan Journey](http://www.tourism.rajasthan.gov.in/travel-diaries/sharadsthan.html): Sharad's travel diary exploring Rajasthan destinations and experiences
- [Ruchika's Rajasthan Journey](http://www.tourism.rajasthan.gov.in/travel-diaries/ruchikasthan.html): Ruchika's travel diary covering Rajasthan tourist destinations
- [Kiara's Rajasthan Journey](http://www.tourism.rajasthan.gov.in/travel-diaries/kiarasthan.html): Kiara's travel diary featuring Rajasthan destinations and experiences

## Optional

- [Circulars and Policies](http://www.tourism.rajasthan.gov.in/circulars-and-policies.html): Official circulars, policies, and tourism regulations for Rajasthan
- [Office Order Circulars](http://www.tourism.rajasthan.gov.in/circulars-and-policies/office-order-circulars.html): Administrative office orders and circulars from Rajasthan Tourism
